item.title: Correction · UCSF Medical Center at Mission Bay: The UCSF hospital's $1.52 billion cost is the…
item.description: The UCSF hospital's $1.52 billion cost is the contractor DPR's stated project value, not a final audited cost. The UC Regents' 2008 presentation gave a different total, a $1.686 billion budget, and the two are not reconciled. Source: DPR Construction, UCSF Medical Center at Mission Bay (https://www.dpr.com/projects/ucsf-medical-center-at-mission-bay); UC Regents, September 2008 (https://regents.universityofcalifornia.edu/regmeet/sept08/j1pp.pdf).

item.title: Correction · UCSF Medical Center at Mission Bay: The opening date cited only ucsf.edu
item.description: The opening date cited only ucsf.edu; it now cites DPR's project page, which says the 289-bed, six-story, 878,000 sq ft, $1.52 billion facility opened for patients on February 1, 2015, and the record's opening and cost entries cite DPR alongside the UCSF news post (which blocks automated fetches). The '10 years of planning and 5 years of construction' split is not in DPR, which says 'over a decade of planning, design and construction', so the summary and notes now say that. The architect credit now follows McDonough's project page (Stantec, formerly Anshen+Allen, and William McDonough + Partners as architects) and DPR (Stantec Architecture), the hospital's use cites McDonough's page, the address cites OSM, the map caveat's parcel example now reads 675 Mission Bay Blvd, about 12.2 acres, and the Wikimedia aerial credit names only the Commons username Firstcultural. Source: DPR Construction, UCSF Medical Center at Mission Bay (https://www.dpr.com/projects/ucsf-medical-center-at-mission-bay); UCSF News, 2014-11 (https://www.ucsf.edu/news/2014/11/121086/ucsf-medical-center-opens-15-billion-next-generation-hospital-complex-mission); William McDonough + Partners, UCSF Medical Center at Mission Bay (https://mcdonoughpartners.com/projects/ucsf-medical-center-at-mission-bay/); OpenStreetMap way 580277612 (https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/580277612); DataSF Parcels (https://data.sf.gov/d/acdm-wktn); Wikimedia Commons, aerial photo file page (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Aerial_photo_of_San_Francisco%27s_Mission_Bay,_ballpark,_and_Caltrain_area.jpg).

item.title: Planned · UCSF Medical Center at Mission Bay: UC Regents Committee on Grounds and… (Sep 17, 2008)
item.description: UC Regents Committee on Grounds and Buildings certifies the project EIR and approves LRDP Amendment #3 for the UCSF Medical Center at Mission Bay; a February 2009 Regents item recounts that "on September 17, 2008, the Regents certified the UCSF Medical Center at Mission Bay EIR and approved LRDP Amendment #3". The same meeting's budget item (J1, September 17, 2008) and the staff presentation asked the Regents to approve the design, the $1.686 billion project budget and the financing ("Today: Request Regents approval of design, EIR and project budget"); no source read reports the outcome of the design, site-plan or budget requests. The presentation concerns this hospital specifically, per its site plan (Attachment, p.15) laying out the hospital buildings, parking and phase boundary (Sep 17, 2008). Source: The Regents of the University of California, 2008-09; The Regents of the University of California, 2008-09-17; The Regents of the University of California, 2009-02-03.
